what: South Korea's mask for the local rules' blend: the distance outside south-korea.poly (Geofabrik's boundary of Korea's OSM extract), from tools/bake_krmask.py
sampling: cell-centred: value (i, j) is at x0 + (i + 0.5) * cell, y0 + (j + 0.5) * cell
encoding: q = clip(floor((d - marginM) / unitM), 0, 255), d the distance (m) outside the poly, 0 inside
blend: w = smoothstep(min(bilinear(q) * unitM / bandM, 1)); w = 1 outside the raster; w is exactly 0 everywhere inside the poly (marginM exceeds cell * sqrt(2))
